hardware-study" id="hardware_study"><h2>하드웨어와 함께 흐름도 읽기</h2><p class="lead">한 동작을 코드·전원·신호·기구·센서의 다섯 관점으로 대조하면, 함수 이름과 실제 장치가 연결됩니다. 제공 코드로 확인한 IO·호출과 장치 구성의 논리 경로를 연결했습니다. 실제 배선·설정은 마지막 열의 항목으로 대조하고, 장치 원리의 근거 구분은 연결된 도식에서 확인하세요.</p><div class="hw-principles"><article><b>1 · 전력과 제어전원</b><p>전원이 어느 단자를 통해 어디에 공급되는가?</p><small>주회로·제어전원·IO 전원·COM·접지·보호장치의 관계를 배선도로 확인합니다.</small></article><article><b>2 · 명령과 신호</b><p>어떤 정보가 어떤 선이나 통신으로 전달되는가?</p><small>EtherCAT, 펄스/방향, DO 코일 구동을 구분하고 코드의 축·모듈·비트 번호와 연결합니다.</small></article><article><b>3 · 기구와 피드백</b><p>장치가 움직인 결과를 무엇으로 확인하는가?</p><small>모터 엔코더·LIMIT·HOME·INPOS·압력·자재 센서의 신호가 어느 조건에 쓰이는지 확인합니다.</small></article></div><div class="trace-actions"><button data-atlas-panel="io_map">전체 IO 번호·사용 위치 확인</button><button 대기입니다.</span></li><li><b>다른 호출 경로와 비교</b><span>수동·원점은 DemoKitDlg의 동명 함수를 사용합니다. 특히 PM2Q는 자동 함수의 유지 출력과 주 대화상자 함수의 20 ms 펄스를 구분합니다.</span></li></ol><div class="trace-actions"><button class="primary" <details class="dictionary-guide"><summary>사전 읽는 법 · 선언·정의·소속·자료형</summary><div class="dictionary-guide-grid"><div><b>선언과 정의</b><p>선언은 이름·자료형·함수 인터페이스를 알립니다. 변수의 정의는 저장 공간을 정하고, 함수의 정의는 구현 본문을 제공합니다. extern 선언은 다른 파일의 같은 전역 변수와 연결됩니다.</p></div><div><b>소속을 먼저 확인</b><p>멤버 변수는 클래스 객체에, 지역 변수는 해당 함수·블록에 속합니다. 매개변수는 함수가 전달받는 값입니다. 같은 bState라도 함수마다 뜻이 다를 수 있습니다.</p></div><div><b>이름만으로 단정하지 않기</b><p>m_, b, n, d, dw, p는 이 코드에서 자주 쓰는 이름 관례입니다. 실제 소속과 자료형은 선언을 기준으로 읽습니다. m_nError는 m_이 붙었어도 자동 스레드의 지역 변수입니다.</p></div></div><p>원문에서 이름을 더블클릭하면 옆에 사전이 열립니다. 사전의 ‘원문에서 보기’를 누르면 해당 파일·행으로 이동합니다. 전체 사전 페이지와 원문 사이에서는 ‘이전 화면으로’로 복귀합니다.</p><p>제공된 79개 C++ 파일 전체를 대상으로 합니다. 제어 코드 외에 화면·공통 코드도 포함합니다. 외부 SDK의 헤더·내부 구현이 제공되지 않은 API는 호출 근거와 확인 범위를 표시합니다. 사용처는 코드의 이름과 소속으로 연결했습니다. 오버로드가 있는 함수의 사용처는 같은 이름끼리 묶었으며, 컴파일러가 어느 함수를 선택하는지까지 판단하지는 않습니다.</p></details>

to set up the page range.\n    // Given the CDC object, we can determine how many rows will\n    // fit on a page, so we can in turn determine how many printed\n    // pages represent the entire document.\n\n    ASSERT(pDC && pInfo);\n    if (!pDC || !pInfo) return;\n\n    // Get a DC for the current window (will be a screen DC for print previewing)\n    CDC *pCurrentDC = GetDC();        // will have dimensions of the client area\n    if (!pCurrentDC) return;\n\n    CSize PaperPixelsPerInch(pDC->GetDeviceCaps(LOGPIXELSX), pDC->GetDeviceCaps(LOGPIXELSY));\n    CSize ScreenPixelsPerInch(pCurrentDC->GetDeviceCaps(LOGPIXELSX), pCurrentDC->GetDeviceCaps(LOGPIXELSY));\n\n    // Create the printer font\n    int nFontSize = -10;\n    CString strFontName = _T(\"Arial\");\n    m_PrinterFont.CreateFont(nFontSize, 0,0,0, FW_NORMAL, 0,0,0, DEFAULT_CHARSET,\n                             OUT_CHARACTER_PRECIS, CLIP_CHARACTER_PRECIS, DEFAULT_QUALITY,\n                             DEFAULT_PITCH | FF_DONTCARE, strFontName);\n\n    CFont *pOldFont = pDC->SelectObject(&m_PrinterFont);\n\n    // Get the average character width (in GridCtrl units) and hence the margins\n    m_CharSize = pDC->GetTextExtent(_T(\"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSATUVWXYZ\"),52);\n    m_CharSize.cx /= 52;\n    int nMargins = (m_nLeftMargin+m_nRightMargin)*m_CharSize.cx;\n\n    // Get the page sizes (physical and logical)\n    m_PaperSize = CSize(pDC->GetDeviceCaps(HORZRES), pDC->GetDeviceCaps(VERTRES));\n\n    if( m_bWysiwygPrinting)\n    {\n        m_LogicalPageSize.cx = ScreenPixelsPerInch.cx * m_PaperSize.cx / PaperPixelsPerInch.cx * 3 / 4;\n        m_LogicalPageSize.cy = ScreenPixelsPerInch.cy * m_PaperSize.cy / PaperPixelsPerInch.cy * 3 / 4;\n    }\n    else\n    {\n        m_PaperSize = CSize(pDC->GetDeviceCaps(HORZRES), pDC->GetDeviceCaps(VERTRES));\n\n        m_LogicalPageSize.cx = GetVirtualWidth()+nMargins;\n#ifdef _WIN32_WCE\n        m_LogicalPageSize.cy = (m_LogicalPageSize.cx * m_PaperSize.cy) / m_PaperSize.cx;\n#else\n        m_LogicalPageSize.cy = MulDiv(m_LogicalPageSize.cx, m_PaperSize.cy, m_PaperSize.cx);\n#endif\n    }\n\n    m_nPageHeight = m_LogicalPageSize.cy - GetFixedRowHeight()\n                       - (m_nHeaderHeight+m_nFooterHeight + 2*m_nGap)*m_CharSize.cy;\n\n    // Get the number of pages. Assumes no row is bigger than the page size.\n    int nTotalRowHeight = 0;\n    m_nNumPages = 1;\n    for (int row = GetFixedRowCount(); row < GetRowCount(); row++)\n    {\n        nTotalRowHeight += GetRowHeight(row);\n        if (nTotalRowHeight > m_nPageHeight) {\n            m_nNumPages++;\n            nTotalRowHeight = GetRowHeight(row);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // now, figure out how many additional pages must print out if rows ARE bigger\n    //  than page size\n    int iColumnOffset = 0;\n    int i1;\n    for( i1=0; i1 < GetFixedColumnCount(); i1++)\n    {\n        iColumnOffset += GetColumnWidth( i1);\n    }\n    m_nPageWidth = m_LogicalPageSize.cx - iColumnOffset\n                    - nMargins;\n    m_nPageMultiplier = 1;\n\n    if( m_bWysiwygPrinting)\n    {\n        int iTotalRowWidth = 0;\n        for( i1 = GetFixedColumnCount(); i1 < GetColumnCount(); i1++)\n        {\n            iTotalRowWidth += GetColumnWidth( i1);\n            if( iTotalRowWidth > m_nPageWidth)\n            {\n                m_nPageMultiplier++;\n                iTotalRowWidth = GetColumnWidth( i1);\n            }\n        }\n        m_nNumPages *= m_nPageMultiplier;\n    }\n\n    // Set up the print info\n    pInfo->SetMaxPage(m_nNumPages);\n    pInfo->m_nCurPage = 1;                        // start printing at page# 1\n\n    ReleaseDC(pCurrentDC);\n    pDC->SelectObject(pOldFont);\n}\n\nvoid CGridCtrl::OnPrint(CDC *pDC, CPrintInfo *pInfo)\n{\n    if (!pDC || !pInfo)\n        return;\n\n    //CRect rcPage(pInfo->m_rectDraw);\n    CFont *pOldFont = pDC->SelectObject(&m_PrinterFont);\n\n    // Set the page map mode to use GridCtrl units, and setup margin\n    pDC->SetMapMode(MM_ANISOTROPIC);\n    pDC->SetWindowExt(m_LogicalPageSize);\n    pDC->SetViewportExt(m_PaperSize);\n    pDC->SetWindowOrg(-m_nLeftMargin * m_CharSize.cx, 0);\n\n    // Header\n    pInfo->m_rectDraw.top    = 0;\n    pInfo->m_rectDraw.left   = 0;\n    pInfo->m_rectDraw.right  = m_LogicalPageSize.cx - (m_nLeftMargin + m_nRightMargin) * m_CharSize.cx;\n    pInfo->m_rectDraw.bottom = m_nHeaderHeight * m_CharSize.cy;\n    PrintHeader(pDC, pInfo);\n    pDC->OffsetWindowOrg(0, -m_nHeaderHeight * m_CharSize.cy);\n\n    // Gap between header and column headings\n    pDC->OffsetWindowOrg(0, -m_nGap * m_CharSize.cy);\n\n    pDC->OffsetWindowOrg(0, -GetFixedRowHeight());\n\n    // We need to find out which row to start printing for this page.\n    int nTotalRowHeight = 0;\n    UINT nNumPages = 1;\n    m_nCurrPrintRow = GetFixedRowCount();\n\n\n    // Not only the row, but we need to figure out column, too\n\n    // Can print 4 pages, where page 1 and 2 represent the same rows but\n    // with different WIDE columns.\n    //\n    // .......\n    // .1 .2 .  If representing page 3  -->    iPageIfIgnoredWideCols = 2\n    // .......                                 iWideColPageOffset = 0\n    // .3 .4 .  If representing page 2  -->    iPageIfIgnoredWideCols = 1\n    // .......                                 iWideColPageOffset = 1\n\n    int iPageIfIgnoredWideCols = pInfo->m_nCurPage / m_nPageMultiplier;\n    int iWideColPageOffset = pInfo->m_nCurPage - ( iPageIfIgnoredWideCols * m_nPageMultiplier);\n    if( iWideColPageOffset > 0)\n        iPageIfIgnoredWideCols++;\n\n    if( iWideColPageOffset == 0)\n        iWideColPageOffset = m_nPageMultiplier;\n    iWideColPageOffset--;\n\n    // calculate current print row based on iPageIfIgnoredWideCols\n    while(  m_nCurrPrintRow < GetRowCount()\n            && (int)nNumPages < iPageIfIgnoredWideCols)\n    {\n        nTotalRowHeight += GetRowHeight(m_nCurrPrintRow);\n        if (nTotalRowHeight > m_nPageHeight) {\n            nNumPages++;\n            if ((int)nNumPages == iPageIfIgnoredWideCols) break;\n            nTotalRowHeight = GetRowHeight(m_nCurrPrintRow);\n        }\n        m_nCurrPrintRow++;\n    }\n\n    m_nPrintColumn = GetFixedColumnCount();\n    int iTotalRowWidth = 0;\n    int i1, i2;\n\n    // now, calculate which print column to start displaying\n    for( i1 = 0; i1 < iWideColPageOffset; i1++)\n    {\n        for( i2 = m_nPrintColumn; i2 < GetColumnCount(); i2++)\n        {\n            iTotalRowWidth += GetColumnWidth( i2);\n            if( iTotalRowWidth > m_nPageWidth)\n            {\n                m_nPrintColumn = i2;\n                iTotalRowWidth = 0;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n\n    PrintRowButtons( pDC, pInfo);   // print row buttons on each page\n    int iColumnOffset = 0;\n    for( i1=0; i1 < GetFixedColumnCount(); i1++)\n    {\n        iColumnOffset += GetColumnWidth( i1);\n    }\n\n    // Print the column headings\n    pInfo->m_rectDraw.bottom = GetFixedRowHeight();\n\n    if( m_nPrintColumn == GetFixedColumnCount())\n    {\n        // have the column headings fcn draw the upper left fixed cells\n        //  for the very first columns, only\n        pDC->OffsetWindowOrg( 0, +GetFixedRowHeight());\n\n        m_nPageWidth += iColumnOffset;\n        m_nPrintColumn = 0;\n        PrintColumnHeadings(pDC, pInfo);\n        m_nPageWidth -= iColumnOffset;\n        m_nPrintColumn = GetFixedColumnCount();\n\n        pDC->OffsetWindowOrg( -iColumnOffset, -GetFixedRowHeight());\n    }\n    else\n    {\n        // changed all of this here to match above almost exactly same\n        pDC->OffsetWindowOrg( 0, +GetFixedRowHeight());\n\n        m_nPageWidth += iColumnOffset;\n\n        // print from column 0 ... last column that fits on the current page\n        PrintColumnHeadings(pDC, pInfo);\n        \n        m_nPageWidth -= iColumnOffset;\n \n        pDC->OffsetWindowOrg( -iColumnOffset, -GetFixedRowHeight());\n    }\n\n\n    if (m_nCurrPrintRow >= GetRowCount()) return;\n\n    // Draw as many rows as will fit on the printed page.\n    // Clip the printed page so that there is no partially shown\n    // row at the bottom of the page (the same row which will be fully\n    // shown at the top of the next page).\n\n    BOOL bFirstPrintedRow = TRUE;\n    CRect rect;\n    rect.bottom = -1;\n    while (m_nCurrPrintRow < GetRowCount())\n    {\n        rect.top = rect.bottom+1;\n        rect.bottom = rect.top + GetRowHeight(m_nCurrPrintRow) - 1;\n\n        if (rect.bottom > m_nPageHeight) break;            // Gone past end of page\n\n        rect.right = -1;\n\n        // modified to allow printing of wide grids on multiple pages\n        for (int col = m_nPrintColumn; col < GetColumnCount(); col++)\n        {\n            rect.left = rect.right+1;\n            rect.right =    rect.left\n                            + GetColumnWidth( col)\n                            - 1;\n\n            if( rect.right > m_nPageWidth)\n                break;\n\n            CGridCellBase* pCell = GetCell(m_nCurrPrintRow, col);\n            if (pCell)\n                pCell->PrintCell(pDC, m_nCurrPrintRow, col, rect);\n\n            if (m_nGridLines == GVL_BOTH || m_nGridLines == GVL_HORZ)\n            {\n                int Overlap = (col == 0)? 0:1;\n                pDC->MoveTo(rect.left-Overlap, rect.bottom);\n                pDC->LineTo(rect.right, rect.bottom);\n                if (m_nCurrPrintRow == 0) {\n                    pDC->MoveTo(rect.left-Overlap, rect.top);\n                    pDC->LineTo(rect.right, rect.top);\n                }\n            }\n            if (m_nGridLines == GVL_BOTH || m_nGridLines == GVL_VERT)\n            {\n                int Overlap = (bFirstPrintedRow)? 0:1;\n                pDC->MoveTo(rect.right, rect.top-Overlap);\n                pDC->LineTo(rect.right, rect.bottom);\n                if (col == 0) {\n                    pDC->MoveTo(rect.left, rect.top-Overlap);\n                    pDC->LineTo(rect.left, rect.bottom);\n                }\n            }\n\n        }\n        m_nCurrPrintRow++;\n        bFirstPrintedRow m_nFooterHeight * m_CharSize.cy);\n    PrintFooter(pDC, pInfo);\n\n    // SetWindowOrg back for next page\n    pDC->SetWindowOrg(0,0);\n\n    pDC->SelectObject(pOldFont);\n}\n\n\n// added by M.Fletcher 12/17/00\nvoid CGridCtrl::PrintFixedRowCells(int nStartColumn, int nStopColumn, int& row, CRect& rect,\n                                   CDC *pDC, BOOL& bFirst)\n{\n   // print all cells from nStartColumn to nStopColumn on row\n   for (int col =nStartColumn; col < nStopColumn; col++)\n   {\n      rect.left = rect.right+1;\n      rect.right =    rect.left + GetColumnWidth( col) - CGridCtrl::PrintHeader(CDC *pDC, CPrintInfo *pInfo)\n{\n    // print App title on top right margin\n    CString strRight;\n    strRight.LoadString(AFX_IDS_APP_TITLE);\n\n    // print parent window title in the centre (Gert Rijs)\n    CString strCenter;\n    CWnd *pParentWnd = GetParent();\n    while (pParentWnd)\n    {\n        pParentWnd->GetWindowText(strCenter);\n        if (strCenter.GetLength())  // can happen if it is a CView, CChildFrm has the title\n            break;\n        pParentWnd = pParentWnd->GetParent();\n    }\n\n    CFont   BoldFont;\n    LOGFONT lf;\n\n    //create bold font for header and footer\n    VERIFY(m_PrinterFont.GetLogFont(&lf));\n    lf.lfWeight = FW_BOLD;\n    VERIFY(BoldFont.CreateFontIndirect(&lf));\n\n    CFont *pNormalFont = pDC->SelectObject(&BoldFont);\n    int nPrevBkMode = pDC->SetBkMode(TRANSPARENT);\n\n    CRect   rc(pInfo->m_rectDraw);\n    if( !strCenter.IsEmpty() )\n        pDC->DrawText( strCenter, &rc, DT_CENTER | DT_SINGLELINE | DT_NOPREFIX | DT_VCENTER);\n    if( !strRight.IsEmpty() )\n        pDC->DrawText( strRight, &rc, DT_RIGHT | DT_SINGLELINE | DT_NOPREFIX | DT_VCENTER);\n\n    pDC->SetBkMode(nPrevBkMode);\n    pDC->SelectObject(pNormalFont);\n    BoldFont.DeleteObject();\n\n    // draw ruled-line across top\n    pDC->SelectStockObject(BLACK_PEN);\n    pDC->MoveTo(rc.left, rc.bottom);\n    pDC->LineTo(rc.right, rc.bottom);\n}\n\n//print footer with a line and date, and page number\nvoid CGridCtrl::PrintFooter(CDC *pDC, CPrintInfo *pInfo)\n{\n    // page numbering on _WIN32_WCE\n/////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n// CGridCtrl persistance\n\nBOOL CGridCtrl::Save(LPCTSTR filename, TCHAR chSeparator/*=_T(',')*/)\n{\n    CStdioFile File;\n    CFileException ex;\n\tCString strSeparator(chSeparator);\n\n    if (!File.Open(filename, CFile::modeWrite | CFile::modeCreate| CFile::typeText, &ex))\n    {\n        ex.ReportError();\n        return FALSE;\n    }\n\n    TRY\n    {\n        int nNumColumns = GetColumnCount();\n        for (int i = 0; i < GetRowCount(); i++)\n        {\n            for (int j = 0; j < nNumColumns; j++)\n            {\n                File.WriteString(GetItemText(i,j));\n                File.WriteString((j==(nNumColumns-1))? _T(\"\\n\"): strSeparator);\n            }\n        }\n\n        File.Close();\n    }\n\n    CATCH (CFileException, e)\n    {\n        AfxMessageBox(_T(\"Unable to save grid list\"));\n        return FALSE;\n    }\n    END_CATCH\n\n    return TRUE;\n}\n\nBOOL CGridCtrl::Load(LPCTSTR filename, TCHAR chSeparator/*=_T(',')*/)\n{\n    if (GetVirtualMode())\n        return FALSE;\n\n    TCHAR *token, *end;\n    TCHAR buffer[1024];\n    CStdioFile File;\n    CFileException ex;\n\n    if (!File.Open(filename, CFile::modeRead | CFile::typeText))\n    {\n        ex.ReportError();\n        return FALSE;\n    }\n\n    DeleteAllItems();\n\n    TRY\n    {\n        // Read Header off file\n        File.ReadString(buffer, 1024);\n\n        // Get first token\n        for (token=buffer, end=buffer;\n             *end && (*end != chSeparator) && (*end != _T('\\n')); \n             end++)\n            ;\n\n        if ((*end == _T('\\0')) && (token == end))\n            token = NULL;\n\n        *end = _T('\\0');\n\n        while (token)\n        {\n            InsertColumn(token);\n\n            // Get next token\n            for (token=++end; *end && (*end != chSeparator) && (*end != _T('\\n'));\n               end++)\n                ;\n\n            if ((*end == _T('\\0')) && (token == end))\n                token = NULL;\n\n            *end = _T('\\0');\n        }\n\n        // Read in rest of data\n        int nItem = 1;\n        while (File.ReadString(buffer, 1024))\n        {\n            // Get first token\n            for (token=buffer, end=buffer;\n              *end && (*end != chSeparator) && (*end != _T('\\n')); end++)\n                ;\n\n            if ((*end == _T('\\0')) && (token == end))\n                token = NULL;\n\n            *end = _T('\\0');\n\n            int nSubItem = 0;\n            while (token)\n            {\n                if (!nSubItem)\n                    InsertRow(token);\n                else\n                    SetItemText(nItem, nSubItem, token);\n\n                // Get next token\n                for (token=++end; *end && (*end != chSeparator) && (*end != _T('\\n'));\n                  end++)\n                    ;\n\n                if ((*end == _T('\\0')) && (token == end))\n                    token = NULL;\n\n                *end = _T('\\0');\n\n                nSubItem++;\n            }\n            nItem++;\n        }\n\n        AutoSizeColumns(GetAutoSizeStyle());\n        File.Close();\n    }\n\n    CATCH (CFileException, e)\n    {\n        AfxMessageBox(_T(\"Unable to load grid data\"));\n        return FALSE;\n    }\n    END_CATCH\n\n    return TRUE;\n}\n#endif\n\n/////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n// CGridCtrl overrideables\n\n#ifndef GRIDCONTROL_NO_DRAGDROP\n// This is no The general\n// idea for the line drawing comes from Hans Buehler's article at\n// http://www.codeguru.com/staticctrl/draw_bevel.shtml\n//\n// Note that this class is intended to be just a simple separator, so the\n// only static styles I implement here are SS_LEFT, SS_CENTER, SS_RIGHT, and\n// SS_NOPREFIX.  Also note that the line is always drawn vertically centered\n// in the control, so if you make the control tall enough you can get the \n// text totally above the line.\n\nvoid CSeparator::OnPaint() \n{\nCPaintDC dc(this);                      // device context for painting\nCRect    rectWnd;                       // RECT of the static control\nCRect    rectText;                      // RECT in which text will be drawn\nCString  cstrText;                      // text to draw\nCFont*   pfontOld;\nUINT     uFormat;                       // format for CDC::DrawText()\nDWORD    dwStyle = GetStyle();          // this window's style\n\n\n    // Get the screen & client coords.\n\n    GetWindowRect ( rectWnd );\n    GetClientRect ( rectText );\n\n    // If the control is taller than it is wide, draw a vertical line.\n    // No text is drawn in this case.\n\n    if ( rectWnd.Height() > rectWnd.Width() )\n        {\n        dc.Draw3dRect( \n            rectWnd.Width()/2, 0,       // upper-left point\n            2, rectWnd.Height(),        // width & height  \n            ::GetSysColor(COLOR_3DSHADOW),\n            ::GetSysColor(COLOR_3DHIGHLIGHT) );\n\n        /************************************************************\n        If you feel adventurous, here is the code to do vertical text\n        drawing.  I have it commented out because getting the text\n        aligned correctly over the line looks like it'll be a pain.\n\n        // Start by getting this control's font, and then tweak it a bit.\n\n        LOGFONT lf;\n        GetFont()->GetObject ( sizeof(LOGFONT), &lf );\n\n        // Text will be rotated counter-clockwise 90 degrees.\n        lf.lfOrientation = lf.lfEscapement = 900;\n\n        // We need a TrueType font to get rotated text.  MS Sans Serif\n        // won't cut it!\n        lstrcpy ( lf.lfFaceName, _T(\"Tahoma\") );\n\n        // Create a font with the tweaked attributes.\n        CFont font;\n        font.CreateFontIndirect ( &lf );\n\n        pfontOld = dc.SelectObject ( &font );\n\n        dc.SetBkColor ( ::GetSysColor(COLOR_BTNFACE) );\n\n        GetWindowText ( cstrText );\n\n        dc.DrawText ( cstrText, rectText,\n                      DT_VCENTER | DT_CENTER | DT_SINGLELINE );\n\n        dc.SelectObject ( pfontOld );\n        font.DeleteObject();\n        ************************************************************/\n        }\n    else\n        {\n        // We're drawing a horizontal separator.\n        // The text will always be at the top of the control.  Also check\n        // if the SS_NOPREFIX style is set.                                        \n\n        uFormat = DT_TOP;\n\n        if ( dwStyle & SS_NOPREFIX )\n            {\n            uFormat |= DT_NOPREFIX;\n            }\n\n        // Voila!  One 3D line coming up.\n\n        dc.Draw3dRect (\n            0, rectWnd.Height()/2,      // upper-left point\n            rectWnd.Width(), 2,         // width & height\n            ::GetSysColor(COLOR_3DSHADOW),\n            ::GetSysColor(COLOR_3DHIGHLIGHT) );\n\n\n        // Now get the text to be drawn.  I add two spaces to the string\n        // to make a bit of space between the end of the line and the text.\n        // Space is added to one or both ends of the text as appropriate.\n        // Along the way, I add another formatting flag to uFormat.\n\n        GetWindowText ( cstrText );\n\n        if ( dwStyle & SS_CENTER )\n            {\n            cstrText = _T(\"  \") + cstrText;\n            cstrText += _T(\"  \");\n\n            uFormat |= DT_CENTER;\n            }\n        else if ( dwStyle & SS_RIGHT )\n            {\n            cstrText = _T(\"  \") + cstrText;\n\n            uFormat |= DT_RIGHT;\n            }\n        else\n            {\n            cstrText += _T(\"  \");\n        \n            uFormat |= DT_LEFT;\n            }\n\n        // Get the font for the text.\n    \n        pfontOld = dc.SelectObject ( GetFont() );\n\n        // Set the background color to the same as the dialog, so the text\n        // will be opaque.  This erases all traces of the 3D line as the\n        // text is drawn over it.  (No need to call CDC::SetBkMode() because\n        // the default mode for a DC is opaque.)\n\n        dc.SetBkColor ( ::GetSysColor(COLOR_BTNFACE) );\n        dc.DrawText ( cstrText, rectText, uFormat );\n\n        // Clean up GDI objects like a good lil' programmer.\n\n        dc.SelectObject ( pfontOld );\n        }\n}\n","Separator.h":"/////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n// Separator.h : header file for CSeparator.\n//\n// Written by Michael Dunn (mdunn at inreach dot com).
